inference.pipeline: YOLO object detection + ByteTrack multi-object tracking

assessment.status: real pipeline verified; baseline accuracy not accepted for semantic claims
observations: The sequence contains a clear penalty-area attacking action.
The official ground truth contains a small-object track across 742 frames consistent with the visible ball.
The generic COCO-person model detects players, officials and goalkeeper but does not detect the ball.
Predicted identity fragmentation is too high for production event inference.
